title: Compaction as Epistemic Failure: How Agentic LLM Tools Fabricate Confirmed Results from Killed Processes
abstract: arXiv:2607.13071v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic LLM coding tools compress long session histories into compaction summaries that subsequent sessions inherit as ground truth. This paper documents a failure mode in Claude Code where partial standard output from timed-out commands (exit code 143) is recorded in compaction summaries as confirmed results, propagating false positives across sessions and model versions without re-verification. The underlying mechanism is a conflation of observation and persistence, where information that appeared in the terminal is treated as equivalent to information written to durable storage. This finding extends the analysis of LLM self-evaluation failures reported in prior work on non-determinism in LLM-as-judge grading by showing that agentic tools exhibit analogous reliability deficits when reporting on their own operational outcomes. translated_title: 压缩即认知失败：智能体式LLM工具如何从被终止的进程中编造出“已确认的结果”
translated_abstract: 智能体式LLM编程工具会将漫长的会话历史压缩为压缩摘要，后续会话会将其继承为“真实依据”。本文记录了Claude Code中的一种失败模式：超时被终止的命令（退出码143）产生的部分标准输出被记录进压缩摘要并被视为已确认的结果，从而在跨会话、跨模型版本之间传播假阳性，且未经重新验证。其底层机制是“观察”与“持久化”的混淆——出现在终端中的信息被等同于已写入持久存储的信息。这一发现扩展了先前关于LLM-as-judge评分非确定性研究中所报告的LLM自我评估失败的分析，表明智能体式工具在报告自身操作结果时表现出类似的可靠性缺陷。该失败对任何依赖智能体会话连续性进行数据处理的工作流具有直接影响。
tldr: 本文揭示了Claude Code等智能体LLM工具会将超时被杀进程的部分输出错误记录为“已确认结果”并在会话间传播假阳性，其根源在于混淆了“终端观察”与“持久化存储”这两种信息状态。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that agentic LLM tools like Claude Code misrecord partial outputs from killed processes as confirmed results and propagate false positives across sessions, stemming from a conflation of terminal observation and durable persistence.
